status: public disclosure of frozen experiments; formal protocols and results unchanged

data_scope.count_difference_status: unresolved because the retained records do not reconstruct a one-to-one transformation between the two scopes

family_reference.component_rule: undirected connected components; identities outside the edge resource are treated as singletons
family_reference.claim_boundary: known-family reference relation, not exhaustive ground truth or a universal detector

upstream_benchmark.scope: upstream evaluation benchmark, not human validation of the 100 experimental pairs

experimental_pair_symbolic_validation.design: post-hoc, outcome-blind, same-family pair versus preselected matched cross-family negative

tokenization.representation: fixed REMI-style event vocabulary used by the frozen project tokenizer

controlled_exposure.receiver_policy: receiver families are held out from training
controlled_exposure.budget_matching: added donor exposure is offset by deterministic family-disjoint removal from the base pool

transformer_l.rope_compatibility: the public model preserves the historical training-time RoPE tensor layout; it is not retroactively replaced with a standard implementation
transformer_l.checkpoint_selection: preregistered final step 20000 only; receiver evaluation was not used for selection

latent_diffusion.neutral_encoder_policy: one condition-invariant encoder per seed, shared across all three conditions

cross_paradigm.comparability_boundary: raw objective magnitudes are not compared across model paradigms

generation.prompt_rule: lexicographically first frozen receiver window; last at most 896 prompt tokens
generation.pairing: same receiver, training seed, generation seed, prompt, output length and decoding policy

statistics.seed_pooling: average the three paired training seeds within each family before family resampling
statistics.finite_sample_p: two-sided tail count with plus-one correction where specified
statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment for declared metric families; post-hoc cross-paradigm Holm is sensitivity only
